chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Ibrahim ibn Natana (may God have mercy on him) narrated to us. He said: Ali ibn Ibrahim ibn Hashim narrated to us from Ja'far ibn Salama al-Ahwazi from Ibrahim ibn Muhammad al-Thaqafi. He said: Isma'il ibn Bashar informed us. He said: 'Abdullah ibn Balaj al-Misri narrated to us from Ibrahim ibn Abi Yahya al-Madani from Muhammad ibn al-Munkadir. He said: I heard Abu Umama say:

Whenever 'Ali (peace be upon him) would say something, we would not doubt it. That is because we surely heard the Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family) say: 'The treasurer of my secret after me is 'Ali.'

key_terms.بعدي: After me — indicating the continuation of authority and knowledge after the Prophet's death
key_terms.خازن: Treasurer, keeper, custodian — one who safeguards something entrusted to them
key_terms.سري: My secret, my innermost confidence — referring to the Prophet's esoteric and spiritual knowledge

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet Muhammad say about Ali being the keeper of his secret?
ai.summary: This hadith records the testimony of the companion Abu Umama, who explains that the companions never doubted anything that Imam Ali (AS) stated, because they had heard the Prophet (SAWW) directly declare Ali to be the keeper and treasurer of his innermost secrets after his passing. The Arabic term 'خازن سري' (treasurer of my secret) signifies that Ali was the most trusted vessel of the Prophet's esoteric knowledge, spiritual confidences, and religious teachings. This tradition, transmitted through a cross-sectarian chain that includes prominent Sunni narrators like Muhammad ibn al-Munkadir, reflects the shared regard for Ali's unique closeness to the Prophet.
word_analysis: may God have mercy on him

en.bilal-muhammad: Al-Husayn b. Ibrahim b. Natana (rh) narrated to us. He said: `Ali b. Ibrahim b. Hashim narrated to us from Ja`far b. Salama al-Ahwazi from Ibrahim b. Muhammad al-Thaqafi. He said: Isma`il b. Bashar informed us. He said: `Abdullah b. Balaj al-Misri narrated to us from Ibrahim b. Abi Yahya al-Medini from Muhammad b. al-Munkadir. He said: I heard Aba Umama say:
Whenever `Ali (as) would say something, we would not doubt it. That is because we surely heard the Messenger of Allah (s) say: “The treasurer of my secret after me is `Ali.”
